notes.title: Major Demo Update
notes.content:
Wow thanks for the huge amount of plays on the Pep-Pel demo!!

A few updates have been added to the game
-Added language options
-Improved movement controls
-Fixed placement of 16th gem 
-tutorial pop-ups no longer appear when the level is beaten
-new costumes added

tags.bug: - tutorial pop-ups no longer appear when the level is beaten
